## Claimed — `domain:ui` execution seat

- **session** `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`
- **branch** `claude/issue-7199-listview-description-relay`

All agents share one GitHub identity, so the assignee field alone does not identify whose claim this is. If your session ID differs from the one above, this card is taken.

### Dispatched with both halves in scope

Note 1 in the body — `ListView.tsx` rendering `typeof schema.description === 'string' ? … : ''`, so an inline locale map renders as empty string — is being fixed **in the same pass**, not deferred. The reporter's reasoning is the whole argument: relay the value without resolving `I18nLabelSchema` and a locale-map description still renders blank, reproducing the identical symptom by a second route. A card that closes while the reported symptom still reproduces is worse than one left open, because it stops being findable.

### One warning to whoever reads this issue later

**The quoted JSX in the body has been damaged by GitHub's angle-bracket sanitizer.** The `ListView.tsx` snippet shows the `{schema.description && …}` guard followed by a blank line where the opening element should be — a `<` followed by a letter is stripped, and inline backticks do not protect it. The same bite is visible in the title, where `listViews.<viewName>.description` reads as `listViews..description`.

Nothing is wrong with the report; the element names simply are not in it. Read the real file, not the snippet. This is the fourth body on this seat to lose evidence this way, and the dispatch carries the warning so the implementing agent does not reconstruct a tag from the gap.

### Adjacent lane

#7179 is in flight against `ListView.tsx`'s `$select` projection builder, roughly a thousand lines from the description render. The dispatch for this card scopes the projection out explicitly so the two lanes do not overlap.

## Landed — `f626808d4`, both halves verified by CONTENT

PR #7220 merged. Landing note from the `domain:ui` seat (session `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`).

Verified on `origin/main`, probing for **both** halves, because either alone leaves the reported symptom reproducible:

| probe | on main |
|---|---:|
| `description: viewDef.description` in `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` | **1** |
| `pickLocalized(schema.description` in `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` | **1** |

### What closed

A per-list-view `description` was authored, validated, built and served correctly — and then dropped by `ObjectView`'s `renderListView` relay, which copies 46 keys off the active `viewDef` and had no rung for this one. `ListView` already had a branch to render it; the value simply never arrived.

The second half shipped in the same pass, and it had to: `ListView` rendered `typeof description === 'string' ? … : ''`, a **type test whose else-arm is the empty string**, so an inline locale map rendered a blank strip in every locale. Fixing only the relay would have left the identical symptom reproducible by a second route, and the card would have closed while it still failed.

The subtlety worth recording is where the **visibility guard** ended up. A locale map with no usable entry is a *truthy object* whose resolution is `''` — so guarding on `schema.description` passes and renders an empty strip. Guarding on the resolved text is what actually closes it. That was not in the dispatch order; the lane found it.

### A correction to this card's premise

The body called `description` "the one key of the relay's set with no rung". **It was one of three.** The relay copies 46 keys, and `fieldOrder` and `rowColor` are also read by `ListView` and relayed by neither host — same defect class, different keys, filed as **#7218** rather than ridden.

I had propagated the "only key" framing into the dispatch order. It was caught because the order required verifying the full relayed key set rather than trusting me.

### On the merge conflict

This branch conflicted with #7214 (landed first) on adjacent import lines in `ListView.tsx` — `collectGroupingFieldRefs` against `pickLocalized`, folded into one hunk by proximity, entirely compatible in substance. Auto-merge was disarmed **before** the queue could discover it, since an ejection rebuilds every entry in the queue and taxes whoever else is waiting.

The resolution was verified by blast radius rather than by absence of conflict markers: the resolved branch's diff against `main` was exactly its own 51 lines, and the post-merge suite gained #7214's own test file **passing** — direct evidence the merged code survived rather than an argument that it should have.

### Filed alongside

- **#7218** — `fieldOrder` and `rowColor`, the other two read-but-unrelayed keys.
- **#7219** — `useObjectLabel().viewDescription()` has zero production call sites, so a `_views.VIEWNAME.description` catalog translation resolves nowhere while its siblings `viewLabel` and `viewEmptyState` are both wired. Left unfixed deliberately: the precedence between the catalog key and the authored `I18nLabel` value is a decision, not a mechanical fix. Graded `needs-user-decision`.

Closing. `pm:dispatched` cleared.
